notes: §1985:XIV.3.4.2 prints the one format 'PURGE cd-name-1'; purgeStatement parses exactly one word after PURGE, BindPurge resolves it as a cd-name of an output or I-O CD (§1985:XIV.3.4.3 SR1, COBOL6170), and MessageControlSession.Purge drops the partial message at run time; the facility is ungated at 85. Probes at --std 85 (pg1, pg2): legal PURGE of an output CD with a 2-entry DESTINATION TABLE and of an I-O CD runs (portion purged: D1.out holds only the later EMI message 'ABCDE'; statuses 00, 70/error key 4 with no portion, 20/'41' unknown destination, 30 for count 0 and 3); zero operands, two operands, a literal and '()' are COBOL0001/0307 parse refusals, an input CD and a CD's subordinate item are COBOL6170. Witness: PURGE WS-ITEM (a data item) refused COBOL6170.

next.reason: 1985: "PURGE cd-name-1"; 2023: "no candidate covers the PURGE statement; the Communication module and its cd-name statements are absent from 2023". No 2023 clause holds PURGE or any cd-name feature. The Communication module this format belongs to is not carried into 2023, so the statement is dropped.
